title: A integração dos ecossistemas de inovação do Brasil e de Portugal no contexto do Web Summit (Diário de Notícias, opinion)
what_it_says: Opinion by Brazil's ambassador to Portugal, Raimundo Carreiro Silva: about 600 Brazilian participants at Web Summit Lisbon in 2022 and about 1,000 in 2023; Porto Digital Europa in Aveiro's innovation hub offers soft landing to Brazilian startups (10 companies); Unicorn Factory Lisboa ran a competition for Brazilian scaleups.
